name: Multi-Agent Bugfix and Review
description: Manager assigns bugfix to coder, reviewer checks tests, coder fixes reviewer feedback, tests pass
prompt: Fix the division by zero error in calculator.py so test_calculator.py passes.

files.test_calculator.py:
from calculator import add, divide
assert add(2, 3) == 5
assert divide(10, 2) == 5.0
assert divide(5, 0) == 0
print('Calculator tests passed.')
